WITH races_with_qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId, c.location
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId)
),
location_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    location,
    COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) as race_count
  FROM races_with_qualifying
  GROUP BY location
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT SUM(race_count) as total FROM location_counts
),
location_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    lc.location,
    lc.race_count,
    CAST(lc.race_count AS REAL) / CAST(tr.total AS REAL) as share
  FROM location_counts lc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM location_shares
)
SELECT 
  ls.location,
  ls.race_count,
  ls.share,
  ls.share - ashr.avg_share as above_average
FROM location_shares ls
CROSS JOIN average_share ashr
WHERE ls.share > ashr.avg_share
ORDER BY ls.location;
